app.name: LibreClinica MUW
app.tagline: Clinical study data platform of the Ophthalmology Department

offline.title: Connection lost
offline.body: You are offline. Submissions will save only after the connection is restored.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address you entered does not exist or the page has moved. Please use the navigation to return to the desired view.

patientsOverview.title: Patient Overview
patientsOverview.description: Cross-study view of every patient you can access.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Manage exam modalities and their item OIDs.

investigator.subjectMatrixDesc: Site-scoped subject list with per-event status. Search, filter, schedule new event, sign subject.
investigator.addSubjectDesc: Enrol a study subject. PHI-aware validation, gender selector, three save modes.
investigator.signQueueDesc: Subjects with completed events ready for e-signature. 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50 attestation.
investigator.todaysCrfsDesc: Subjects with events in data-entry-started state or scheduled for today.
investigator.openQueriesDesc: Discrepancies assigned to me. Respond from the CRF entry view.

monitor.subjectMatrixDesc: Browse subjects and their CRFs read-only. Open a CRF to review data and raise queries.
monitor.sdvDesc: Completed CRFs across all subjects with SDV requirement. Bulk-verify, inline Add Query.
monitor.openQueriesDesc: Cross-subject query + annotation list with status / type / assigned-to-me filters.
monitor.auditLogDesc: Gapless timeline with diff cards on reason-for-change. Filter by actor / event type / subject.

dataManager.buildStudyDesc: Seven-task setup tracker with progress bar and per-task status.
dataManager.manageUsersDesc: Per-user role + site + auth method. Pending invites badge.
dataManager.importCrfDesc: Multi-step wizard: Upload → Map → Preview & resolve → Commit.
dataManager.rulesDesc: Validation + workflow rules attached to event-CRFs.
dataManager.dataExportDesc: Saved datasets for the active study — trigger ODM, CSV, TSV, Excel, SAS, or SPSS exports and download generated files.

administrator.manageUsersDesc: User accounts, role bindings per study, pending invites, password resets.
administrator.editStudyDesc: Study name, sponsor, protocol number, summary, dates.
administrator.createStudyDesc: Provision a top-level study. You are auto-bound as study coordinator.
administrator.sitesDesc: Site identity + activation + per-site user roles.
administrator.auditLogDesc: Platform audit trail with diff cards on every change.
administrator.dataExportDesc: Saved datasets for the active study — trigger exports and download generated files.
administrator.modalitiesDesc: Manage measurement modalities + their per-eye item OIDs.

home.switchStudyDesc: Pick another study you are assigned to. Only your bound studies are shown.

adminJobs.title: Scheduled jobs
adminJobs.subtitle: Read-only listing of every Quartz trigger registered against the application's shared scheduler.
adminJobs.name: Name

contact.brandLine: Department of Ophthalmology and Optometry, Medical University of Vienna
contact.title: Contact the administrator
contact.subtitle: Send a message to the LibreClinicaMUW administrator. Include enough detail that we can help quickly.
contact.name: Your name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.successBody: The administrator has been notified. We may reply to the email address you provided.
contact.privacyNote: Your message is delivered as a plain email to the institutional administrator. Do not include patient-identifying information.
contact.errorUnavailable: Contact form is not currently accepting messages; please contact the sysadmin directly.
contact.errorGeneric: Failed to send your message. Please try again later.
contact.errorNetwork: Network error — please check your connection and try again.

adminPasswordPolicy.title: Password policy
adminPasswordPolicy.subtitle: Defaults applied to every local account. SSO accounts inherit policy from the institutional IdP.
adminPasswordPolicy.changeRequiredOnFirstLogin: Force password change on first login

adminConfig.title: Application configuration
adminConfig.subtitle: Read-only — at MUW these are env-var driven. Use this view to verify what the running JVM actually sees.

subjectMatrix.title: Subject Matrix
subjectMatrix.empty: No subjects match the current filter.
subjectMatrix.scheduleHint: Pick a subject below to schedule the next visit.

addSubject.title: Add Study Subject
addSubject.intro: Once saved, the subject's identifying fields cannot be changed without contacting the Study Coordinator. Do not include personally identifying information in Secondary ID.

helper.subjectId: The identifier used in source documents. Cannot be edited after save.
helper.dateOfBirth: Full date of birth. Used for cross-study duplicate detection.

matchDialog.title: Possible existing patient ({n})
matchDialog.description: This patient triplet matches one or more existing subjects. Link to the existing record or confirm this is a different person.

linkPatient.linkConflict409: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Both records are already linked to different patients.

addSubject.phiWarning: Never include name, hospital ID, social security number, or any other identifying data.

error.labelTaken: Study Subject ID '{id}' is already taken in this study.

addSubject.cancelLink: Cancel and return to Subject Matrix
addSubject.modesHelp: Save modes: "Schedule first event" opens the subject view (event scheduler lands in a later sub-phase). "Add next" keeps you here with a clean form. "Finish" returns to the Subject Matrix.

sdv.title: Source Data Verification
sdv.subTrail: All sites · view by Event CRF
sdv.empty: No CRFs match the current filter.
sdv.selectAllAriaLabel: Select all verifiable CRFs in the current view

unverify.title: Roll back verification?
unverify.intro: The SDV stamp is cleared and the CRF returns to the verification queue. The action is recorded in the audit trail with the reason you provide.
unverify.unknownError: Unknown error while rolling back verification.

confirm.title: Mark as verified?
confirm.body: All {count} selected CRFs will be flipped to Verified (SDV). The action is recorded in the audit log.
confirm.note: If data on a verified CRF is later changed, its SDV status resets to Pending automatically.
confirm.auditNote: Audit trail entry will reference monitor_demo + the timestamp.

query.title: Add Note
query.descriptionPlaceholder: What needs clarifying? Reference the source document if relevant…
query.auditTrailTell: Audit trail entry will reference: monitor_demo · timestamp

notes.title: Notes & Discrepancies
notes.empty: No discrepancies match the current filter.

composer.typeReasonForChangeRoleHint: Reason for change is available to Data Managers and Administrators only.

auditLog.title: Study Audit Log
auditLog.intro: Every data change, sign-off, SDV event, query, and administrative action. Immutable. Filters narrow the view; nothing is ever hidden.
auditLog.empty: No events match the current filter.

systemTrail.title: System audit trail
systemTrail.subtitle: All audit events including operation failures and job failures.

crfEntry.title: CRF data entry
crfEntry.lockedBanner: This CRF is locked because the subject is signed. No edits are accepted. Contact the study lead to reopen.
crfEntry.completedBanner: This CRF is completed. Fields are read-only. Click «Reopen CRF» to edit.
crfEntry.completedBannerNoReopen: This CRF is completed. Fields are read-only. Contact the study lead to reopen.

action.reopenConfirm: Reopen this CRF for editing? Previously signed-off data will be editable again. The action is recorded in the audit trail.

rfc.headerTell: This CRF was previously marked complete. Edits require a documented reason.
rfc.prompt: Please document the reason for changing {count} item(s):|Please document the reason for changing {count} item(s):
rfc.placeholder: e.g. Lab value re-keyed from corrected source document.
rfc.missingForItem: A reason is required for this change.

group.deleteRowConfirm: Delete this row? Existing values will be removed from the audit-visible record.
group.empty: No rows yet. Use "Add row" to start a new entry.

file.dropPrompt: Drop a file here or use Browse.
file.removeConfirm: Remove the attached file? The deletion is recorded in the audit trail.
file.tooBig: File exceeds the configured size limit.
file.badExtension: File type is not in the allowed list.

concurrentEdit.bannerTitle: Another user is editing this CRF

userAutocomplete.placeholder: Search user by name, username, or email…

noteDialog.heading: New query on {itemLabel}
noteDialog.errorTooLong: Description must be 4000 characters or fewer

bilateral.compoundSlotMissing: Sub-field {subKey} is not defined on this CRF

prefill.errorFetch: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Vorherige Werte konnten nicht geladen werden.

banner.blindSecondPass: Blind second pass — enter the values from the paper original. The first-pass values are not visible to you.

reconcile.title: DDE reconciliation

reasonForChange.label: Reason for change
reasonForChange.placeholder: Required — short justification recorded in the audit trail

reconcile.openCount: {count} item still needs reconciliation | {count} items still need reconciliation

errors.sameClerk: You entered Pass 1 — a different clerk must perform Pass 2.
errors.notDdeEnabled: This CRF is not enabled for double data entry.
errors.noLongerOpen: This conflict is no longer open (someone else may have resolved it).

buildStudy.title: Build Study
buildStudy.intro: Seven setup tasks. Complete them in any order; each card deep-links to its workflow when the supporting view ships.

statusDialog.title: Move study to {target}?
statusDialog.intro: The transition is recorded in the audit trail and cascades to all child sites. Locked / Frozen transitions require a reason for the audit log.
statusDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. GCP-mandated lock after database lock review
statusDialog.reasonRequired: Reason is required for Locked / Frozen transitions.

create-study.title: Create study
create-study.description: Study metadata, version, OID, sponsor + protocol number.

crf.title: Design CRFs
crf.description: Form library: item grids, response sets, repeating groups.

events.title: Define events
events.description: Visit schedule with per-event CRF assignment + SDV requirement.

rules.title: Validation rules
rules.description: Field-level and cross-form predicates with action types.

users.title: Users
users.description: Per-site Investigators, Monitors, Data Managers, CRCs.

groupClasses.title: Subject groups
groupClasses.intro: Define how subjects are classified — randomisation arms, family relationships, demographic strata, or ad-hoc groupings. Each class owns a set of groups subjects can be assigned to.
groupClasses.disableConfirm: Remove group class "{name}"? Subjects already classified into its groups stay in the audit trail; new classifications use the remaining classes. The action is recorded in the audit trail.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: View what validation, discrepancy-note, show/hide, and notification rules attach to this study. Pick a target on the left to see the attached rules + actions. Editing rules still requires the legacy XML import workflow — inline authoring is queued in a follow-up slice.
rules.empty: No rules defined on this study yet.
rules.searchPlaceholder: Filter by target OID, CRF, rule name, expression…
rules.pickPrompt: Pick a rule_set on the left to see its attached rules + actions.

detail.runLogEmpty: No fire history for this rule set yet.

test.heading: Test rule
test.intro: Parse and evaluate an expression against optional mock values. Useful for sanity-checking range checks and boolean composition before they go into a rule. Variable references against the live study scope are not supported by this surface; use the legacy Test Rule screen for that.

dryRun.heading: Dry-run preview
dryRun.empty: No actions would fire under the current data.

actionEdit.title: Edit action
actionEdit.notEditable: Inline edit not supported for {type}. Delete + recreate via the wizard.

confirm.disableRuleSet: Disable rule set on {target}? Existing fire history stays in the audit trail; the rules stop evaluating until restored.
confirm.disableRule: Disable rule {ruleOid} on this rule set? The other rules attached to the same target stay active.

saveError.timeRequired: Time is required when scheduling is on.

create.heading: Author a new rule
create.actionTypeNote: Inline create supports Discrepancy / Email / Show / Hide only. Use XML import for other action types.

field.oidHint: Uppercase letters, digits, underscores. Must start with a letter. e.g. RUL_BP_HIGH
field.name: Display name
field.targetHint: OID path the rule attaches to, e.g. ITEM_BP.GROUP1.CRF1.SED1

result.heading: Rule authored
result.summary: Created 1 rule, 1 rule set, and 1 action.

import.ignoreDuplicates: Ignore duplicate rules (skip rather than overwrite)
import.parserActiveNote: The legacy XML import pipeline runs server-side: schema validation, expression validation against your study, and cycle detection. Rejected entries don't persist.

preview.summary: {validRules} new + {duplicateRules} duplicate + {invalidRules} invalid rules · {validRuleSets} new + {duplicateRuleSets} duplicate + {invalidRuleSets} invalid rule sets

sites.title: Sites
sites.intro: Create child sites under this study. Each site is a study row with its own facility metadata + role bindings; subjects + events are scoped per site. The active study must be the top-level parent — switch via the picker if you're currently on a site.
sites.createHeading: Create a site under this study
sites.empty: No sites configured under this study yet.
sites.disableConfirm: Remove site "{name}"? Existing subjects + events at this site stay in the audit trail but become inaccessible until restored. The action is recorded in the audit trail.

crfLibrary.title: CRF Library
crfLibrary.intro: Manage the form library shared across all studies in this deployment. Upload .xls / .xlsx spreadsheets to create new versions; attach versions to event definitions on the Events surface.
crfLibrary.parserActiveNote: Uploaded spreadsheets are parsed server-side. Items, sections, response sets, and version metadata are extracted on submit; rejected rows / cells surface as field errors below the file picker.
crfLibrary.parseErrorsHeading: The parser rejected the spreadsheet ({count} issue(s)):
crfLibrary.uploadIntro: Choose a .xls / .xlsx file. Give the version a short name (e.g. v1.0, v1.1). The revision notes field captures what changed since the previous version.
crfLibrary.disableConfirm: Remove CRF "{name}"? Active assignments stay intact for audit but new data entry is blocked. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
crfLibrary.disableVersionConfirm: Remove version "{version}" of "{name}"? Subjects currently entering data against this version are unaffected; new data entry will use the remaining versions.
crfLibrary.empty: No CRFs in the library yet.
crfLibrary.lockConfirm: Lock version "{version}" of "{name}"? Subjects entering data are unaffected; the version becomes read-only and event definitions that defaulted to it surface the next available version.
crfLibrary.unlockConfirm: Unlock version "{version}" of "{name}"? Writes resume for this version.
crfLibrary.restoreConfirm: Restore version "{version}" of "{name}"? The version becomes available again. Run the legacy /RestoreCRFVersion path if you need the section + item_data cascade.
crfLibrary.hardRemoveConfirm: Permanently delete version "{version}" of "{name}"? This drops the row and every associated item / section / response set. Sysadmin only. The action cannot be undone.

hardRemoveBlocker.eventDefs: {count} event definition(s) default to this version:
hardRemoveBlocker.eventCrfs: {count} event-CRF row(s) carry data against this version (sample: {sample}).
hardRemoveBlocker.remediation: Run the Migrate dialog to reassign defaults to another version, then retry.

migrate.dryRunHeading: Dry-run preview — no rows will be written
migrate.noSeds: No event definitions currently default to "{from}" — nothing to migrate.

ophthCatalog.title: Add from ophthalmology catalog
ophthCatalog.subtitle: Pre-defined fields with OID + unit + modality binding — pick one to insert into the current section.

author.heading: Author new version of "{name}"
author.itemsEmpty: No items yet — add at least one to enable submit.
author.bilateralToggleHint: OD-prefixed items render on the LEFT, OS on the RIGHT (clinician-facing). "+ Add item" creates an OD/OS pair.

review.heading: Review and submit
review.intro: On submit the server synthesises an XLS workbook from this draft and runs it through the legacy CRF parser. The resulting version is semantically identical to one uploaded via the upload-version flow.
review.incomplete: Some required fields are still blank — go back and fill them in to enable submit.
review.parseErrors: The parser rejected the synthesised workbook ({count} issue(s)):

dataType.BLHelper: Boolean items render as a single checkbox (Yes = 1 / No = 0). The response set is fixed, so the options picker is hidden.

responseType.matrixHelper: Response types compatible with data type {dataType}.

showWhen.toggleHint: When enabled, this item only appears when another item's value matches the rule.
showWhen.sourceHelper: Only items declared before this one are eligible, so evaluation order stays linear.
showWhen.noEarlierItems: No earlier items are available. Add an item before this one to use as the source.
showWhen.literalHelper: Compared against the source item's stored value at runtime.

comparator.eqHelper: Show when the source item's value equals the literal.
comparator.neHelper: Show when the source item's value does not equal the literal.
comparator.gtHelper: Show when the source item's value is greater than the literal (numeric comparison).
comparator.ltHelper: Show when the source item's value is less than the literal (numeric comparison).
comparator.gteHelper: Show when the source item's value is greater than or equal to the literal.
comparator.lteHelper: Show when the source item's value is less than or equal to the literal.

errors.sourceRequired: Pick the source item the rule should look at.
errors.sourceMissing: The selected source item is no longer available — pick another item.
errors.literalRequired: Enter the value to compare against.

item.name: Item name
item.oidHelper: Auto-suggested from the item name; override if you need a specific identifier.

responseSetPicker.title: Response set
responseSetPicker.label: Label
responseSetPicker.labelHelper: Reusable identifier — pick something descriptive like "yes_no" or "snellen_lines".
responseSetPicker.saveFailed: Could not save the response set.

canvas.heading: [NEEDS_REVIEW] CRF builder
canvas.versionDescriptionPlaceholder: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Short description of changes in this version

errors.validationFailed: [NEEDS_REVIEW] The inputs are incomplete or invalid — please check the highlighted fields below.

BL.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Boolean
BL.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Yes / No as a single checkbox.

TRISTATE_REASON.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Yes / No / Unknown + reason
TRISTATE_REASON.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Three-state selector with conditional reason field.

canvas.dropHere: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Drag building blocks or presets from the left panel here.

section.bilateralOn: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Bilateral active — items shown in OD/OS grid. Click to switch to unilateral.
section.bilateralOff: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Unilateral — items in a flat list. Click to switch to bilateral (OD left / OS right).

properties.title: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Properties
properties.noSelection: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Select an item in the canvas to edit its properties.
properties.oidHelper: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Suggested from the item name; can be overridden.

dataTypeHint.INT: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Whole number without decimals, e.g. letter count.
dataTypeHint.REAL: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Numeric value with decimals, e.g. mmHg.
dataTypeHint.BL: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Yes/no value, stored as a boolean column.
dataTypeHint.TRISTATE_REASON: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Three-state: Yes / No / Unknown plus a required reason on “No”.

responseTypeHint.radio: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Single choice as radio buttons (compact, all options visible).
responseTypeHint.single-select: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Single choice as dropdown (compact for many options).
responseTypeHint.checkbox: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Single checkbox (yes/no) or list of checkboxes.
responseTypeHint.calculation: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Value is computed automatically from other items.

validation.atLeastOneSection: [NEEDS_REVIEW] At least one section is required.
validation.atLeastOneItem: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Section must contain at least one item.
validation.calculationFormulaRequired: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Calculation formula must not be empty.
validation.fileResponseSetRequired: [NEEDS_REVIEW] FILE items require a 'file' response set.
validation.itemNameInvalidChars: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Item name may only contain letters, digits and underscores.
validation.dataTypeUnsupported: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Data type is not accepted by the server.
validation.responseTypeUnsupported: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Response type is not accepted by the server.
validation.duplicateItemName: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Duplicate item name in this section.

iop.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] IOP measurement
iop.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Tonometry with Yes/No/Unknown plus conditional IOP value or reason.

ophthExam.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Ophthalmology bilateral examination
ophthExam.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] OD/OS pairs for standard measurements (BCVA, IOP, CCT, CRT).

bcva.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] BCVA (ETDRS letters)
bcva.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Best-corrected visual acuity per ETDRS — letters per eye plus optional refraction (sphere / cylinder / axis).

rnfl.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] RNFL (peripapillary, Heidelberg HRA / Spectralis ONH)
rnfl.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Peripapillary nerve fiber layer — global mean + quadrants (S/T/I/N) + signal quality per eye.

thicknessMap.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Macular thickness map (ETDRS 9-subfield)
thicknessMap.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] ETDRS macular grid with nine subfields per eye plus device modality (Spectralis / Cirrus / Topcon).

slitLamp.label: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Slit-lamp — anterior segment
slitLamp.description: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cornea / AC / iris / lens / vitreous per eye + overall remark.

ophthPreset.triggerHint: Tip: type OPHTH_EXAM (or OPHTHA_EXAM) and press Shift+Enter to insert the ophthalmology preset.

bilateral.missingOd: (no OD item — add one to complete the pair)
bilateral.missingOs: (no OS item — add one to complete the pair)

section.title: Ophthalmology examination
section.instructions: Bilateral measurements — OD on the left, OS on the right (clinician's perspective).

picker.heading: Ophthalmology bilateral examination
picker.subheading: Pick measurements to add as paired OD / OS items in an OPHTH_EXAM section.
picker.lateralityHint: Each selection becomes two items: OD (right eye, renders on the left) and OS (left eye, renders on the right). Operators can rename or remove individual items after generation.

REFRACTION_COMPOUND.label: Refraction (Sphere / Torus / Angle / Visus)
REFRACTION_COMPOUND.subFields: four sub-fields per eye — inserted together

crfPreview.heading: Preview · {crfName}
crfPreview.banner: Preview mode — no data is persisted.

file.stub: File upload is disabled in preview mode.

assignCrfs.title: Manage CRF assignments
assignCrfs.empty: No CRFs attached yet. Attach the first one from the library below.
assignCrfs.noVersionsNote: This CRF has no uploaded versions yet. Go to the CRF library and upload a .xls/.xlsx version first.
assignCrfs.noEligibleCrfsNote: Every CRF in the library is already attached. Create more CRFs in the library to attach more.
assignCrfs.removeConfirm: Detach CRF "{crf}" from event "{event}"? Existing data on this CRF stays in the audit trail; new entries against this event will no longer include the CRF. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
assignCrfs.auditNote: All attaches, role changes and detaches are recorded in the audit trail.

eventDefinitions.title: Event definitions
eventDefinitions.intro: Define the visit schedule for this study. Each event represents a scheduled visit, an unscheduled add-hoc visit, or a common event applied to every subject. CRF assignments live alongside in the CRF library.
eventDefinitions.repeatingLabel: Repeating event (can occur multiple times per subject)
eventDefinitions.disableConfirm: Remove event "{name}"? Existing CRFs scheduled against it remain in the audit trail but become inaccessible. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
eventDefinitions.restoreConfirm: Restore event "{name}"? Auto-removed CRFs and item data flip back to available; rows that were explicitly removed stay removed. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
eventDefinitions.lockConfirm: Lock event "{name}"? Active CRFs, event-CRFs, and item data on every subject flip to locked — data entry is blocked until unlock. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
eventDefinitions.unlockConfirm: Unlock event "{name}"? Locked CRFs and item data flip back to available on every subject. The action is recorded in the audit trail.

studyForm.name: Study name
studyForm.uniqueProtocolIdHint: Short identifier used in every URL. Letters, digits, underscores, dashes. Cannot be changed after creation.

create.title: Create a new study
create.intro: Defines the protocol identity. You'll be enrolled as Coordinator on the new study and can configure events, CRFs, and sites from its dashboard. Sysadmin only.

edit.title: Edit study identity
edit.intro: Fields marked with an asterisk are required. Every change emits an audit-trail entry recording the old and new values.
edit.saved: Saved. Changes are reflected throughout the platform.

manageUsers.title: Manage Users
manageUsers.searchPlaceholder: Find user by name, username or email…
manageUsers.empty: No users match the current filter.

invite.title: Invite a new user
invite.studyMissing: Pick an active study before inviting a user.
invite.emailNotWiredNote: Welcome email delivery is not yet wired — copy the one-time password and share it with the new user via a secure channel.
invite.ssoNotWiredNote: No password is generated. After submit, the user signs in via the institutional SSO portal — make sure their institutional identity is provisioned at the IdP.
invite.successIntro: User created. Share this one-time password with the new user; they will be required to change it on first login.
invite.ssoSuccessIntro: User created. They will sign in via the institutional SSO portal — no password is needed.
invite.ssoSuccessHint: Make sure their institutional identity is provisioned at the IdP before they attempt to sign in.
invite.firstLoginNote: The password is shown once and is not stored. Make sure it is captured before closing this dialog.

authMethod.label: Authentication method
authMethod.localHelp: A one-time password will be generated and shown after the user is created.
authMethod.ssoHelp: The user signs in through the institutional identity provider. No password is generated.

invite.externalIdHelp: Case-sensitive. Must match the principal the IdP sends in the eduPersonPrincipalName header.

edit.title: Edit user profile
edit.roleNote: Manage role bindings from the Roles dialog.

lifecycle.disableConfirm: Disable user {username}? They will be unable to log in. Their study-role bindings are soft-deleted alongside; re-enabling restores them. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
lifecycle.restoreConfirm: Re-enable user {username}? A new one-time password is generated; they must change it on first login. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
lifecycle.unlockConfirm: Unlock user {username}? The account lock is cleared, the failed-login counter is reset, and a new one-time password is generated; they must change it on first login. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
lifecycle.restoredIntro: User {username} is re-enabled. Share the one-time password via a secure channel.
lifecycle.unlockedIntro: User {username} is unlocked. Share the one-time password via a secure channel.
lifecycle.restoredNoPassword: The credential is owned by the directory or identity provider — no local password was generated. Tell the user they may log in with their existing credentials.

locked.tooltip: Account locked by too many failed login attempts. Use Unlock to restore access.

resetPassword.confirm: Reset {username}'s password? A new one-time password is generated; they must change it on first login. The current password is invalidated immediately. The action is recorded in the audit trail.

roles.title: Manage role bindings
roles.empty: No active role bindings on visible studies.
roles.revokeConfirm: Revoke {username}'s role on study {study}? Their access to that study is removed; their data on the study is unaffected. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
roles.removeStudyConfirm: Remove every role of {username} on study {study}? Their access to that study is fully revoked; their data on the study is unaffected. The action is recorded in the audit trail.
roles.saveError: Saving roles failed. Please try again.
roles.auditNote: All grants, role changes, and revocations are recorded in the audit trail.

retinalParked.title: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Parked scans
retinalParked.subtitle: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Cross-study list of retinal inference jobs uploaded without a visit, awaiting assignment. Sysadmin-only.

toast.bindRaced: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Already assigned by someone else — list refreshed.
toast.noEventCrf: [NEEDS_REVIEW] No CRF for this visit yet — open the subject's visit first so the CRF is initialised, then re-assign.

bulkBind.bulkConfirm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Assigning {count} scans to the next visit.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.subTitle: Map exam modalities to per-eye item OIDs.

action.deleteConfirm: Remove modality {code}? Existing baselines stay; the panel will no longer surface this row.

error.duplicateCode: A modality with this code already exists.
error.unknownOid: Item OID '{oid}' not found in any active CRF version.
error.missingOid: Provide at least one of OD OID / OS OID.
error.network: Could not save the modality — please try again.

list.title: Patient Overview
list.subtitle: Cross-study list of every patient with an active enrolment you can see.

importCrf.title: Import CRF Data
importCrf.intro: Bulk-load completed CRFs from CDISC ODM XML. The import is staged — nothing is committed until you confirm at the final step.

upload.heading: Upload CDISC ODM 1.3 XML
upload.description: Subject / event / CRF / item must already be defined in the study.
upload.errorXsd: The file is not a valid CDISC ODM 1.3 XML payload.
upload.errorWrongStudy: The file's studyOID does not match the active study — switch study first or re-export from the source.

terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.body1: I understand that LibreClinica MUW is a clinical-data system under ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10. Every action I take is recorded in an immutable audit log.
terms.body2: I will not share my credentials, will sign off the system when I leave my workstation, and will protect any subject identifiers visible on screen.
terms.body3: I understand that my role grants access only to data and actions consistent with my study assignment; access outside that scope is flagged in the audit log and reviewed.
terms.ackTerms: I have read and accept the terms above.
terms.ackAuditing: I understand that every action I take is recorded and auditable.

createDataset.title: New dataset
createDataset.blurb: Compose a reusable dataset definition: pick the scope (events, CRFs, items), set the inclusion flags, and review.

createDataset.filtersBlurb: Restrict the exported rows by subject, event status, or item value.
createDataset.filtersPlaceholderBlurb: The Phase 3 ticket adds subject filters, event-status filters, and per-item value filters. Until then the dataset exports every row matching the scope you selected on step 1.
